# Natrvash

> Natrvash is an architectural photography and film studio based in Dubai, UAE, working across the Middle East and beyond. It is run by Navid Atrvash (art director and architectural photographer, M.Arch, University of Tehran) and Ava Izadpanah (stylist and architectural videographer). The studio photographs and films architecture, interiors and hospitality for architects, interior designers and brands, and retouches architectural photographs for photographers worldwide.

Navid Atrvash is also known as Navid (Ali) Atrvash. Navid and Ava are spouses and creative partners, and co-founders of Natrvash. Legal name: Navid Atrvash Photography Services L.L.C.

Recognition: IPA (International Photography Awards) Honorable Mention 2025 and Official Selection 2025 and 2026; Architecture MasterPrize Best of Best 2025 and Winner 2026; European Photography Awards Gold 2025; Architecture Photography Awards 2nd Place 2026; PERSPA Honourable Mention 2026. Work published by ArchDaily, designboom, Parametric Architecture, Amazing Architecture and 2A Magazine.

Contact: hello@natrvash.com · Navid: navid@natrvash.com, +971 50 287 0027 · Ava: ava@natrvash.com, +971 50 581 2585 · Instagram @natrvash

## Studio

- [Home](https://www.natrvash.com/): film, selected photographs, the studio and the portfolio
- [About](https://www.natrvash.com/about): the studio, its founders, awards and publications
- [Navid Atrvash](https://www.natrvash.com/navid): art director, architectural photographer, retoucher and visual artist
- [Ava Izadpanah](https://www.natrvash.com/ava): set stylist and architectural videographer

## Work

- [Selective Projects](https://www.natrvash.com/selective): architecture, interior and hospitality projects, including Vakil Metro Station (Brickwave), Greenland Convention Center, Sang-e Siah Boutique Hotel, Molavi Café and Villa No. 07
- [Retouching](https://www.natrvash.com/retouching): architectural photo retouching for photographers worldwide — exposure and flash blending, sky replacement and dusk conversion, removal of people, cars and reflections, perspective and colour correction, matched to each photographer's style; two revision rounds; quotes on request

## Visual art

- [Maelstrom](https://www.natrvash.com/maelstrom): 2019 art series by Navid Atrvash, digital painting and acrylic on print, with figures from Jane Dieulafoy's travelogue
- [Thousands of Flowers](https://www.natrvash.com/thousands-of-flowers): 2016 collection within Braided Photos, Navid Atrvash's pattern method; seven solo exhibitions including the Cité internationale des Arts, Paris
